cases.label: 공개 진입점에서 내부 함수를 노출하지 않는다
검증 뒤 시각을 읽고 완성된 영수증을 한 번 저장한다
cases.probe: const calls=[]; let saved;let frozenAtPersist=false; const service=submission.createReceiptService({now(){calls.push('now');return 1700000000000;},persist(value){calls.push('persist');saved=value;frozenAtPersist=Object.isFrozen(value)&&Object.isFrozen(value.items)&&value.items.every(Object.isFrozen);}}); const receipt=service.issue({id:'o-1',items:[{sku:'a',quantity:2,unitPrice:1200},{sku:'b',quantity:1,unitPrice:500}]}); observe({receipt,calls,frozenAtPersist,same:saved===receipt,frozen:Object.isFrozen(receipt)&&Object.isFrozen(receipt.items)&&receipt.items.every(Object.isFrozen)});

cases.label: 인스턴스별 의존성과 매번 읽는 시각을 분리한다
cases.probe: let tick=10; const storedA=[]; const storedB=[]; const a=submission.createReceiptService({now:()=>tick++,persist:r=>storedA.push(r.createdAt)}); const b=submission.createReceiptService({now:()=>99,persist:r=>storedB.push(r.createdAt)}); const order={id:'empty',items:[]}; const receipts=[a.issue(order),b.issue(order),a.issue(order)]; observe({times:receipts.map(r=>r.createdAt),totals:receipts.map(r=>r.total),storedA,storedB});

cases.label: 동결 입력을 보존하고 반환 중첩 값을 공유하지 않는다
cases.probe: const item=Object.freeze({sku:'free',quantity:1,unitPrice:0,privateNote:'keep'}); const order=Object.freeze({id:' o ',items:Object.freeze([item]),extra:'keep'}); const service=submission.createReceiptService({now:()=>0,persist:()=>{}}); const result=service.issue(order); observe({result,original:order,newItems:result.items!==order.items,newItem:result.items[0]!==item});

cases.label: 잘못된 주문을 시계·저장 호출 전에 거부한다
cases.probe: const calls=[]; const service=submission.createReceiptService({now(){calls.push('now');return 0;},persist(){calls.push('persist');}}); const errors=[]; for(const order of [null,{id:'',items:[]},{id:'x',items:[{sku:'a',quantity:0,unitPrice:1}]},{id:'x',items:[{sku:'a',quantity:1,unitPrice:1.5}]},{id:'x',items:[{sku:'a',quantity:2,unitPrice:Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER}]}]){try{service.issue(order);errors.push('returned');}catch(error){errors.push(error.name);}} observe({errors,calls});

cases.label: 잘못된 어댑터와 시각을 저장 전에 거부한다
cases.probe: const invalid=[]; for(const adapters of [null,[],{}, {now:0,persist(){}}]){try{submission.createReceiptService(adapters);invalid.push('returned');}catch(error){invalid.push(error.name);}} const clock=[]; let saves=0; for(const value of [undefined,'0',NaN,Infinity]){try{submission.createReceiptService({now:()=>value,persist(){saves++;}}).issue({id:'x',items:[]});clock.push('returned');}catch(error){clock.push(error.name);}} observe({invalid,clock,saves});

cases.label: 시계·저장의 실패를 같은 값으로 전파한다
cases.probe: const first={code:'clock'}; const second=undefined; let saves=0; const outcomes=[]; for(const [now,persist,reason] of [[()=>{throw first;},()=>{saves++;},first],[()=>1,()=>{saves++;throw second;},second]]){try{submission.createReceiptService({now,persist}).issue({id:'x',items:[]});outcomes.push(false);}catch(error){outcomes.push(Object.is(error,reason));}} observe({outcomes,saves});
